== English Reflections III comparison ==
The original Reflections III Defensive Shield has no Grabber icon. The Advanced Rulebook lists it as a Grabber. Its E-marked full face and the current D-E1 face and slip show the added icon. The printed stacking and retrieval reduction clauses are unchanged. The separate Coruscant Effect has its own comparison.
